# Nondetection (`spells:nondetection`)
**Level 3 [Abjuration](../magic-schools/abjuration.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (a pinch of diamond dust worth, 25+ GP, which the spell consumes) | **Duration:** 8 hours | **Classes:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from Divination spells. The target can be a willing creature, or it can be a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can't be targeted by any Divination spell or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
